สัปดาห์ที่ 12: Flutter Mobile IoT & MQTT Dashboard
(Cross-Platform Mobile Application Development)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

- Flutter Engine & Widget Tree
- Reactive Programming Paradigm
- Mobile vs Embedded Networking

- JSON Serialization & Stream Handling
- Auto-Reconnect Strategy

- Separation of Concerns (UI vs Net)

- Modern Glassmorphism & Dark Mode
